::: {.callout-note .se-question appearance="simple"}
## The question

[Change package margins within a section of the document](https://tex.stackexchange.com/questions/5842/change-package-margins-within-a-section-of-the-document), asked by [Vass](https://tex.stackexchange.com/users/1026/vass) on TeX Stack Exchange (2010-11-23; [CC BY-SA 2.5](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/)):

> I am using a style file that I found for a CV but I need to include the cover letter with the CV in a single file. So I am just putting the cover letter on the first page. The margins though are too small on the right hand side. So how can I override this and put more space on that side?
:::

It would be easier to make your CV and cover letter separate documents and use a PDF utility to combine them.  The PDF utility could be LaTeX with the [`pdfpages`][1] package. 

  [1]: http://ctan.org/pkg/pdfpages
